reuse.why: Adds Fintegra through a generalised linkExternalAccount and a parameterised download (downloadFileScopedTransactions) instead of copying, and all six handlers share the guard and saveLinkedAccount; only unlinkAccount is not moved onto the new clearAccountLink.

duplication.why: Removes the repeated create-or-upgrade blocks across providers; the one remaining copy is clearAccountLink, which duplicates the field list still inlined in unlinkAccount.

placement.why: Link rules and helpers live in server/accounts/app.ts and the download in sync.ts as the tree does, though clearing replaced holders inside saveLinkedAccount and the closed check inside assertBankAccountNotLinked blur responsibilities.

scope.why: Delivers the four steps but also folds three providers into a new generic link function, renames the Pluggy download and widens DbAccount's sync-source type, a sizeable refactor beyond what was asked.

maintainability.why: Far less per-provider code to keep in sync; minor smells are a misleadingly named assert that also checks closed accounts and returns ids to clear, and option flags (sendFileId, tables) for preserved provider differences.

bypasses_abstraction.where: Link handlers go through assertBankAccountNotLinked and saveLinkedAccount; only unlinkAccount keeps its own inline copy of the clearing update

disguised_duplication.where: clearAccountLink is a plain copy of unlinkAccount's update, not disguised

abstraction_drift.where: assertBankAccountNotLinked gains replaceExistingLink and a folded-in closed-account branch; saveLinkedAccount gains replacedIds; unlinkAccount bypasses clearAccountLink
